title: Brush Engagement No Suggestions
description: Brush tool shows no preview or engagement suggestions when hovering near unconnected nodes (e.g. tambour). Fix brush slot hit-testing and anchor positions to match indirect-handle UX.
summary: Brush previews now finalize on slot exit: WASM host materializes the placed node/edge before clearing the overlay, brushPlace carries stable nodeId/edgeId to the fixture, and authoring peers mark the descriptor dirty and invalidate so the GPU host syncs immediately.
